title: Uniquement en anglais
body: Dommage que l’application soit qu’en anglais, elle a l’air intéressante mais pour quelqu’un qui n’est pas bilingue... inutile..
author: kirabzh

title: Very misleading and not worth it
body:
They withdraw money using another company’s name (personality path) and the only way to cancel your subscription is through mail.. they used to respond really quickly by mail but when I asked to cancel they were very vague and eventually stopped answering and now I’m being charged for NOTHING.. just to be clear, I subscribed through their website not the app.
I don’t even receive anything from them so I’m literally being charged for nothing so..
